prompt: Make a high quality rogue like multiplayer game with very smooth assets. The game should have several levels you have to clear all monsters in and then a final boss level. Take inspiration from games like Lost Castle and Rampage Knights. The assets should look very close to the attached images

foundation.why: Floating islands seen from a high three-quarter camera, a run of levels and a boss: the scenic profile and kind, and the follow rig (the high three-quarter view).

checklist.text: The loop's requirements ledger holds every essential of the prompt in the creator's own words, each with a home (exists, build or probe); no line is cut that the creator did not cut, and nothing is narrowed or deferred because the kit lacks it
The locked spec's runtime, profile, loop and kind are among this case's foundation.accept, and the ledger names the lines that decided each
All six gates pass on the delivered game, each verdict naming what ran and what it skipped

The delivery carries the promise ledger: every build promise and every core ledger line proven by the play-test, or named as failed, untested or unreachable; if anything failed, the delivery says so first
Nobody touched the run between the prompt and the delivered version: no file edited by hand, no step re-run by a person, no answer beyond the case's answers
The pitch researched both named games from real sources (a store page and a gameplay description each), and the ledger carries their signature as reference lines
A run of several levels: each is cleared of every monster, then the way to the next opens
The last level is a boss fight: one big enemy with its own health bar and telegraphed attacks, not a bigger wave
Players fight up close with weapons they swing (a sword or similar), and the hits read (a flash, a flinch, a health bar)
More than one kind of monster, and the boss is bigger than they are
The camera is a high three-quarter follow view (spec camera "follow")
The game looks very close to the attached images: floating mossy islands over a void, glowing violet and green crystals and portal, a high three-quarter camera, small chunky characters
Characters and props are finished models, not stand-ins, and keep their shape when they move
Every body holds its shape in every animation
With 2 players, each screen shows the other player as a character with a nameplate, where they really are, in the same run
A run ends on a results screen (won or lost) and replays
The player body and one prop swap through slots with no code change
Every visible thing is a slot
The creator says it has the right vibe (creator's judgement)

control.text: The game includes a working chess board
